maya: Starting regional rollout for v3.2.1 — US first. Change window 00:30-06:30 UTC. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% (5m soak) -> 20% hold 10m. EU pinned to v3.2.0 until US green. APAC on hold.
tom: Confirmed. US baseline qps ~11k; warm pool + burst ~4k. 20% should fit.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated stage=canary region=us pct=2 version=v3.2.1 id=deploy_2987654321
sre-oncall: Rollback criteria? Exact thresholds so alerts can fire.
maya: Rollback on: p99 +220ms sustained 3m OR errors >0.5% for 5m OR OOM. On trigger: pin slice and post to #incidents.
raj: I'll run synthetic set D and smoke at 75% before 20%.
deploy-bot: canary health (5m): ok. p99 within baseline.
tom: Bumping to 10%. warming caches.
raj: smoke run: requests=7200 errors=0.06% p99=305ms (baseline 290ms) -> within ceiling.
maya: Proceed to 20% and hold. If anything odd, flip pin command below.
```
# fast pin command
redwoodctl route set --slice europe --version v3.2.0 --force
```
sre-oncall: Standing by. Will auto-page if p99 delta >220ms for 3m.
deploy-bot: canary health (10m at 20%): ok. no alerts.
maya: US canary healthy. Scheduling EU unpin review in 15m. APAC next window. Closing thread unless escalation.
